shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -100 && cat CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null

cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && ls __agent_eval__ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/ 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ ; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ | head -80

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n/i18n.js; echo ----; grep -n "lang\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.js | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/i18n/ru.json 2>/dev/null

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.js; echo ----; grep -rn "configure\|Lang" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/ru.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/i18n/en.json; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/Pagination.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TableColumnSetup/i18n/en.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc 2>/dev/null; node -v

cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Pagination/types.d.ts; echo ----; sed -n 1,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n "interface ControlGroupProps" -A 20 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; echo ----; ls node_modules/.bin | grep -i "vitest\|tsc\|vite"; ls node_modules | grep -i "jsdom\|happy"

rm -rf dist && (which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; node -e "require.resolve('playwright')" 2>&1 | head -1; node -e "require.resolve('puppeteer')" 2>&1 | head -1); git status --short
